bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 11 PM PDT THIS EVENING... Combined seas 6 to 8 ft, increasing to 8 to 10 ft around the afternoon ebb today. Combined seas will decrease back to 3 to 5 ft on Monday. Bar conditions moderate, becoming rough around the afternoon ebb on Sunday. Bar conditions becoming light on Monday. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 445 PM Sunday, 500 AM Monday, and 515 PM Monday. The Sunday and Monday afternoon ebbs will be very strong.
